Class RTCConnectionDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.rtc.RTCConnectionDiagnostics
public final class RTCConnectionDiagnostics extends Object
Immutable bounded snapshot. Retry delays use monotonic time; topology freshness uses UTC.
